description: Header file containing helper functions, class declarations, and constants for Vulkan renderer utilities in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Abstract base class for Vulkan context error handling.

classes.name: ObjectAndSerial
classes.description: Template class managing Vulkan objects with serial numbers for tracking.

classes.name: GarbageObject
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan object scheduled for deferred destruction.

classes.name: MemoryProperties
classes.description: Manages Vulkan physical device memory properties.

classes.name: StagingBuffer
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan buffer used for staging data.

classes.name: Shared
classes.description: Shared ownership of Vulkan objects with reference counting.

classes.name: Recycler
classes.description: Object pool for recycling Vulkan objects.

methods.name: AppendToPNextChain
methods.description: Appends a Vulkan structure to the pNext chain.

methods.name: GetAvailableValidationLayers
methods.description: Checks for available Vulkan validation layers.

methods.name: VulkanResultString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a VkResult.

methods.name: GetDepthStencilAspectFlags
methods.description: Returns aspect flags for depth/stencil formats.

methods.name: GetFormatAspectFlags
methods.description: Returns aspect flags for a given format.

methods.name: GetImpl
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation object for a given GL object.

methods.name: GetImplType
methods.description: Gets the Vulkan implementation type for a GL object.

methods.name: GetMaxSampleCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported sample count.

methods.name: GetSampleCount
methods.description: Returns a supported sample count at least as large as requested.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Converts a GL offset to VkOffset3D.

methods.name: GetExtent
methods.description: Converts GL extents to VkExtent3D.

methods.name: GetImageType
methods.description: Returns VkImageType for a given GL texture type.

methods.name: GetImageViewType
methods.description: Returns VkImageViewType for a given GL texture type.

methods.name: GetColorComponentFlags
methods.description: Returns VkColorComponentFlags based on color channels.

methods.name: GetShaderStageFlags
methods.description: Returns VkShaderStageFlags for active shaders.

methods.name: GetViewport
methods.description: Calculates VkViewport from GL rectangle and parameters.

methods.name: GetExtentsAndLayerCount
methods.description: Determines VkExtent3D and layer count from GL texture info.

methods.name: InitDebugUtilsEXTFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for VK_EXT_debug_utils.

methods.name: InitDebugReportEXTFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for VK_EXT_debug_report.

methods.name: InitGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2KHRFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for VK_KHR_get_physical_device_properties2.

methods.name: InitImagePipeSurfaceFUCHSIAFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for FUCHSIA image pipe surface.

methods.name: InitExternalMemoryHardwareBufferANDROIDFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for Android hardware buffer.

methods.name: InitGGPStreamDescriptorSurfaceFunctions
methods.description: Loads extension functions for GGP stream descriptor surface.
